data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is artificial. The first model (qwen) returned 'inconclusive' solely because it encountered HTTP 400 API errors when trying to audit the LICENSE and .SRCINFO files. The second model (deepseek) successfully audited all files and correctly found no security issues. There was no substantive security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review LICENSE and .SRCINFO due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for LLM API errors on individual files so that a transient failure on a non-critical file (like LICENSE) does not force an 'inconclusive' verdict for the entire package.
Reinforce in prompts that HTTP sources pinned with strong checksums (e.g., SHA256) are safe from supply-chain injection, ensuring models do not flag transport-layer hygiene issues as security risks.
